title: One Figure, Every Canvas: Editable Flowchart Relayout via Agentic Pipeline
title_zh: 一图多用，画布随心：基于智能体流程的流程图自适应重排

paragraphs.en: Pipeline figures in ML papers must be repurposed across many canvases, including paper columns, 16:9 slides, portrait posters, 1:1 social teasers, 9:16 phone previews. Each format imposes a different aspect ratio on the same computational graph, where any silently broken connection misrepresents the method. We formulate aspect-ratio-adaptive flowchart relayout as a distinct task: given a raster flowchart and a target ratio, produce a structurally faithful, hallucination-free, editable layout. Existing methods fail characteristically: image-to-image models stretch blocks and reject extreme ratios, text-to-image agentic systems hallucinate content, and parse-then-render systems mis-route edges. We propose an agentic pipeline factored into Parse, Style, and Layout stages, each pairing a main agent with a critic that combines deterministic constraint checks with VLM visual feedback so connectivity is explicitly checked and prevented from being silently broken. Outputs are draw.io-editable mxGraph XML. On a curated benchmark of 100 flowcharts at five aspect ratios, evaluated by Gemini 3.1 Pro and validated against human judgments, our method reaches 68.6% Content Fidelity versus 11.2–41.4% for prior work. Project page: https://onefigureeverycanvas.vercel.app/
paragraphs.zh: 机器学习论文中的流程图表必须被重新用于多种画布，包括论文专栏、16:9 幻灯片、竖版海报、1:1 社交媒体预告图以及 9:16 手机预览图。 每种格式都对相同的计算图施加了不同的宽高比，其中任何未被察觉的连接中断都会错误地呈现该方法。 我们将适应宽高比的流程图重新布局定义为一个独立任务：给定一个光栅化流程图和目标宽高比，生成一个结构忠实、无幻觉且可编辑的布局。 现有方法存在典型缺陷：图像到图像模型会拉伸区块并拒绝极端宽高比，文本到图像的智能体系统会产生幻觉内容，而解析后渲染的系统则会错误连接边线。 我们提出了一种分阶段的智能体流程，分为解析、样式和布局三个阶段，每个阶段都将一个主智能体与一个评论者配对，后者结合确定性约束检查与 VLM 视觉反馈，从而明确检查并防止连接被悄然中断。 输出为支持 draw.io 编辑的 mxGraph XML 文件。 在包含 100 个流程图、覆盖五种宽高比的精选基准数据集上，通过 Gemini 3.1 Pro 进行评估并与人类判断验证后，我们的方法实现了 68.6% 的内容保真度，而先前工作的保真度仅为 11.2%–41.4%。 项目页面：https://onefigureeverycanvas.vercel.app/

paragraphs.en: Pipeline figures are central to how vision and ML research is communicated, yet the same diagram has to live across many canvases: paper columns, 16:9 slides, portrait posters, 1:1 social teasers, 9:16 phone previews. Each target imposes a different aspect ratio on the same computational graph, and every conversion must preserve the original blocks, edges, and flow direction. Any silently broken connection misrepresents the method. Manually re-laying out figures for each canvas is tedious and error-prone. As shown in Fig. 1 , our goal is to produce structure-preserving relayouts at arbitrary aspect ratios from a single source figure, with each output remaining editable in draw.io for further refinement.
paragraphs.zh: 流程图表在视觉和机器学习研究的传播中占据核心地位，但同一张图却需要适配多种画布：论文专栏、16:9 幻灯片、竖版海报、1:1 社交媒体预告图以及 9:16 的手机预览图。 每种目标画布都对相同的计算图施加了不同的宽高比要求，而每一次转换都必须保留原有的模块、连接边和流向方向。 任何未被察觉的连接中断都会导致方法表述失真。 为每种画布手动重新布局图表既繁琐又容易出错。 如图 1 所示，我们的目标是从单一源图出发，生成任意宽高比下仍能保留结构的重新布局版本，且每个输出结果都可在 draw.io 中继续编辑以进行进一步优化。

paragraphs.en: Recent work on automating scientific-figure creation falls into three families. Image-to-image (I2I) models such as Nano Banana Pro and GPT Image 2.0 re-synthesize the source figure at a requested resolution. Text-to-image agentic systems, PaperBanana ( Zhu et al., 2026a ) , SciFig ( Huang et al., 2026b ) , and Paper2Poster ( Pang et al., 2025 ) , orchestrate planner, stylist, and critic agents to create a new figure from a methodology description. A third line targets editability: AutoFigure-Edit ( Lin et al., 2026 ) emits SVG, while AutomaTikZ ( Belouadi et al., 2023 ) and DeTikZify ( Belouadi et al., 2024 ) use TikZ. All target figure generation from textual or programmatic inputs; none takes an existing flowchart and refits it to an arbitrary canvas while keeping its computational graph intact.
paragraphs.zh: 近期关于自动化科学图表生成的研究可分为三大类。 图像到图像（I2I）模型，如 Nano Banana Pro 和 GPT Image 2.0，会以指定的分辨率重新合成源图。 文本到图像的智能体系统，包括 PaperBanana（Zhu 等人，2026a）、SciFig（Huang 等人，2026b）和 Paper2Poster（Pang 等人，2025），通过协调规划器、风格师和评论家智能体，根据方法论描述生成新的图表。 第三类研究则聚焦于可编辑性：AutoFigure-Edit（Lin 等人，2026）输出 SVG 格式，而 AutomaTikZ（Belouadi 等人，2023）和 DeTikZify（Belouadi 等人，2024）则使用 TikZ。 所有这些系统都以文本或程序性输入为目标生成图表；但没有一个系统能够接收现有的流程图，并在保持其计算图完整性的前提下，将其重新适配到任意的画布中。

paragraphs.en: When repurposed for relayout, each family exhibits a categorical failure mode (Fig. 2 ). I2I models resize in pixel space. Embedded panels and blocks are uniformly stretched, and ratios outside 3:1–1:3 are rejected. T2I agentic systems re-synthesize from a prompt, dropping source blocks and adding labels not present in the source. Parse-then-render systems recover the components but mis-route edges, breaking the directed graph that the flowchart exists to communicate. None simultaneously achieves the three properties this task requires: structural fidelity, hallucination-freedom, and arbitrary canvas resizing in a downstream-editable format. As summarized in Table 1 , these methods produce non-editable raster outputs, lack native flowchart-editor support, or cannot resize an existing flowchart to arbitrary canvases.
paragraphs.zh: 当这些模型被重新用于布局调整时，每个模型族都会表现出一种分类故障模式（图 2）。 I2I 模型在像素空间中进行尺寸调整。 嵌入式面板和区块会被均匀拉伸，且超出 3:1–1:3 范围的比率将被拒绝。 T2I 智能体系统会根据提示重新合成图像，丢弃源图中的区块，并添加源图中不存在的新标签。 “解析-再渲染”系统虽然能恢复各组件，但会错误连接边，从而破坏流程图本身用于传达信息的有向图结构。 没有任何一种方法能同时满足本任务所需的三项特性：结构保真性、无幻觉生成能力，以及以下游可编辑格式实现画布的任意尺寸调整。 如表 1 所示，这些方法要么生成不可编辑的光栅化输出，要么缺乏对原生流程图编辑器的支持，要么无法将现有流程图调整到任意尺寸的画布上。

paragraphs.en: We introduce an agentic pipeline for aspect-ratio-adaptive flowchart relayout. Given a raster flowchart F 0 F_{0} and target ratio r r , our method produces a draw.io-compatible mxGraph XML X ∗ X^{*} that preserves the structure, content, and style of F 0 F_{0} while fitting the new canvas. Since directly resolving structure, appearance, and spatial arrangement in a single step is difficult, we decompose the problem into three stages, each pairing a main agent with a critic (Fig. 3 ). The Parse stage recovers structured XML from F 0 F_{0} with SAM 3 ( Carion et al., 2025 ) spatial priors; the Style stage reconstructs visual appearance while extracting colors deterministically to mitigate unreliable VLM color perception; and the Layout stage rearranges the recovered graph for the target canvas, combining deterministic structural checks with VLM visual feedback to prevent connectivity errors. We further curate flowcharts from oral papers at top-tier venues, evaluate them at five target ratios, and propose four VLM-as-a-Judge metrics validated against human judgments. Our pipeline reaches 68.6% Content Fidelity versus 11.2–41.4% for prior work.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了一种用于适应不同宽高比流程图重新布局的智能体式流程。 给定一个光栅流程图 F₀ 和目标比例 r，我们的方法能够生成一个兼容 draw.io 的 mxGraph XML 文件 X*，该文件在保持 F₀ 的结构、内容和风格的同时，能适配新的画布。 由于直接在一部中解决结构、外观和空间布局的问题十分困难，我们将该问题分解为三个阶段，每个阶段都将一个主智能体与一个评论者配对（图 3）。 解析阶段利用 SAM 3（Carion 等，2025）的空间先验知识从 F₀ 中恢复结构化 XML；风格阶段在重构视觉外观的同时以确定性方式提取颜色，以减少 VLM 对颜色感知的不确定性；布局阶段则将恢复的图重新排列以适应目标画布，结合确定性的结构检查与 VLM 的视觉反馈，以防止连接错误。 我们还从顶级会议的口述报告中整理出流程图，在五种目标比例下对其进行评估，并提出了四种经过人类判断验证的“VLM 作为裁判”指标。 我们的流程实现了 68.6% 的内容保真度，而先前工作的这一指标仅为 11.2%–41.4%。

paragraphs.en: We formulate aspect-ratio-adaptive flowchart relayout as a distinct task and propose the first agentic pipeline for it, factored into Parse, Style, and Layout stages, each guarded by a critic combining VLM reasoning with deterministic verification so connectivity is explicitly checked and prevented from being silently broken.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将适应宽高比的流程图重布局定义为一个独立任务，并为此提出了首个智能体式流程管道。该管道分为解析、样式和布局三个阶段，每个阶段都由一个评论器进行监督，该评论器结合了视觉语言模型推理与确定性验证，从而显式检查连接性，防止其被静默破坏。

paragraphs.en: We construct FlowchartRelayoutBench , a benchmark pairing flowcharts from CVPR/ICCV/ECCV/NeurIPS/ICLR/ICML oral papers at five target ratios (9:16, 2:3, 1:1, 3:2, 16:9) with a four-metric VLM-as-a-Judge protocol (Relationship Preservation, Hallucination-free Rate, Layout Quality, Style Similarity) validated against human assessments.
paragraphs.zh: 我们构建了 FlowchartRelayoutBench，这是一个基准测试，它将 CVPR/ICCV/ECCV/NeurIPS/ICLR/ICML 口头报告论文中的流程图按照五种目标比例（9:16、2:3、1:1、3:2、16:9）进行重新布局，并采用包含四项指标（关系保留率、无幻觉率、布局质量、风格相似度）的“VLM 作为裁判”协议进行评估，该协议已通过人类评估验证。

paragraphs.en: Experiments and a user study show that our pipeline substantially outperforms both monolithic VLM and existing agentic figure systems on the structural-fidelity dimensions that matter most for cross-canvas relayout.
paragraphs.zh: 实验和用户研究表明，我们的流程在跨画布重新布局中最重要的结构保真度维度上，显著优于整体式VLM和现有的智能体驱动型图像系统。

paragraphs.en: Scientific figure generation has evolved from one-shot synthesis ( Rodriguez et al., 2023 ; Belouadi et al., 2023 ; Belouadi et al., 2024 ) to planner–critic agents for charts ( Dibia, 2023 ; Yang et al., 2024 ; Goswami et al., 2025 ; Han et al., 2023 ) , slides ( Zheng et al., 2025 ; Zheng et al., 2026 ) , posters ( Pang et al., 2025 ) , diagrams ( Zala et al., 2023 ; Wei et al., 2025 ) , pipeline and architecture figures ( Zhu et al., 2026a ; Huang et al., 2026b ; Zhu et al., 2026b ; Lin et al., 2026 ; Liu et al., 2026b ; Guo et al., 2026b ) , and layouts ( Lin et al., 2023a ; Guo et al., 2026a ) , with dedicated benchmarks ( Zhang et al., 2025 ; Tang et al., 2026 ) . Concurrent systems improve editability through structure–style–layout decomposition ( Wang et al., 2026 ) , PowerPoint or SVG outputs ( Shao et al., 2026 ; Zhao et al., 2026 ) , and programmatic checks ( Zhao et al., 2026 ) . We similarly use multi-agent decomposition, but refit an existing raster flowchart to a target canvas while preserving structure and style.

paragraphs.en: Classical graph drawing includes Sugiyama layering ( Sugiyama et al., 1981 ; Gansner et al., 1993 ) , Graphviz ( Gansner & North, 2000 ) , ELK ( Domrös et al., 2023 ) , constraint-based routing ( Dwyer et al., 2008 ; Wybrow et al., 2009 ) , and aspect-ratio-aware heuristics ( Nachmanson et al., 2007 ) , and underpins learned layouts based on transformers ( Lee et al., 2020 ; Gupta et al., 2021 ; Jiang et al., 2023 ) , diffusion ( Inoue et al., 2023 ; Zhang et al., 2023 ; Levi et al., 2023 ; Iwai et al., 2024 ) , LLMs ( Feng et al., 2023 ; Lin et al., 2023b ; Tang et al., 2023 ) , and content-aware objectives ( Hsu et al., 2023 ; Li et al., 2023 ; Horita et al., 2024 ) . Related retargeting adapts images ( Avidan & Shamir, 2023 ; Rubinstein et al., 2010 ) or visualizations to different displays ( Hoffswell et al., 2020 ; Kim et al., 2022 ; Wu et al., 2020 ; Kim et al., 2021 ; Kim et al., 2023 ; Liu et al., 2026a ) . These methods do not explicitly preserve directed-graph connectivity under arbitrary canvas changes. Our Layout stage combines hierarchical drawing with VLM feedback and deterministic checks for edge preservation and overlap.
paragraphs.zh: 经典的图绘制方法包括 Sugiyama 分层法（Sugiyama 等，1981；Gansner 等，1993）、Graphviz（Gansner & North，2000）、ELK（Domrös 等，2023）、基于约束的路由方法（Dwyer 等，2008；Wybrow 等，2009）以及考虑宽高比的启发式方法（Nachmanson 等，2007），并为基于变换器的布局学习（Lee 等，2020；Gupta 等，2021；Jiang 等，2023）、扩散模型（Inoue 等，2023；Zhang 等，2023；Levi 等，2023；Iwai 等，2024）、大型语言模型（Feng 等，2023；Lin 等，2023b；Tang 等，2023）以及内容感知目标函数（Hsu 等，2023；Li 等，2023；Horita 等，2024）提供了基础。 相关的重定向方法可将图像（Avidan & Shamir，2023；Rubinstein 等，2010）或可视化结果适配到不同的显示设备（Hoffswell 等，2020；Kim 等，2022；Wu 等，2020；Kim 等，2021；Kim 等，2023；Liu 等，2026a）。 这些方法并未在画布发生任意变化时显式保留有向图的连通性。 我们的布局阶段将分层绘制与 VLM 反馈相结合，并通过确定性检查确保边的连通性和无重叠。

paragraphs.en: Since instance identity, visual appearance, and spatial arrangement are tightly coupled, direct end-to-end parametrization is ill-posed. Therefore, we decompose the transformation into three sequential stages, each handled by a main agent paired with a Critic Agent that iterates until convergence. In the Parse Stage , F 0 F_{0} is converted into a structured mxGraph XML X X encoding every block, edge, and group. In the Style Stage , X X is refined into a styled XML X ^ \hat{X} whose visual properties reflect those of F 0 F_{0} . In the Layout Stage , X ^ \hat{X} is rearranged into the target canvas r r , producing X ∗ X^{*} with all inter-block relationships preserved. Every intermediate representation remains in mxGraph XML and can be rendered to PNG at any stage, enabling visual verification and direct editing in draw.io. An overview is shown in Fig. 3 .
paragraphs.zh: 由于实例身份、视觉外观和空间布局紧密耦合，直接的端到端参数化是病态的。 因此，我们将变换分解为三个连续阶段，每个阶段由一个主智能体与一个评论智能体配合处理，并迭代直至收敛。 在解析阶段，F₀ 被转换为结构化的 mxGraph XML 编码 X，其中包含每个块、边和组的信息。 在样式阶段，X 被细分为带样式的 XML X̂，其视觉属性反映了 F₀ 的视觉属性。 在布局阶段，X̂ 被重新排列到目标画布 r 上，生成 X*，同时保留所有块间关系。 每个中间表示都保持为 mxGraph XML 格式，并且可以在任何阶段渲染为 PNG，从而实现视觉验证和直接在 draw.io 中编辑。 概述如图 3 所示。

After each iteration, the Critic Agent compares F 0 F_{0} , X X , and its draw.io-rendered PNG to verify connector logic, structural consistency, and visual correspondence, returning correction instructions until the result passes or the iteration limit is reached (Fig. 4 ; Appendix G.1 and G.2 ).

paragraphs.zh: 风格阶段将 X X 精炼为具有特定风格的 XML X ^ \hat{X}，使其与 F 0 F_{0} 的视觉外观一致，同时保留其恢复后的结构和语义。 为了减少 VLM 的颜色感知错误，基于 PIL 的颜色提取工具从 F 0 F_{0} 中提取每个色块的颜色分配信息，这些信息来自 XML 中记录的色块位置；随后，风格智能体会更新填充色、描边颜色、文本样式和箭头样式，同时保持色块文本、边的源/目标引用以及组别成员关系不变。 每次迭代结束后，批评智能体都会将 F 0 F_{0}、X ^ \hat{X} 的渲染结果以及提取的颜色分配信息进行比较，以验证视觉对应性，并返回修正指令，直到结果通过验证或达到迭代上限（图 4；附录 G.3 和 G.4）。

paragraphs.en: We introduce FlowchartRelayoutBench , a benchmark pairing 100 source flowcharts at five target ratios with a four-metric VLM-as-a-Judge protocol under hierarchical scoring.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出 FlowchartRelayoutBench，这是一个基准测试，它将 100 个源流程图与五个目标比例进行配对，并采用分层评分下的“VLM 作为评判者”的四项指标协议。

paragraphs.en: The dataset comprises 100 flowcharts from oral-level and above papers at top-tier AI/CV venues over the past three years: ECCV (30), CVPR (30), NeurIPS (12), ICLR (10), ICCV (9), and ICML (9). To cover heterogeneous source-diagram structures, we deliberately curate examples spanning three predefined structural-complexity levels: 25 easy, 40 medium, and 35 hard flowcharts. The benchmark contains 15.5 nodes and 13.6 edges per figure on average, with both quantities generally increasing with structural complexity. Detailed definitions, statistics, and performance breakdowns for the three levels are provided in Appendix A . Each source is evaluated at five baseline-supported aspect ratios (9:16, 2:3, 1:1, 3:2, 16:9), yielding 500 relayout tasks.
paragraphs.zh: 该数据集包含过去三年中顶级人工智能/计算机视觉会议（ECCV（30）、CVPR（30）、NeurIPS（12）、ICLR（10）、ICCV（9）和 ICML（9））发表的论文中的 100 张流程图，这些流程图的难度均达到口语水平或以上。 为了涵盖异构的源图结构，我们特意挑选了涵盖三种预定义结构复杂度级别的示例：25 个简单流程图、40 个中等难度流程图和 35 个困难流程图。 该基准数据集平均每张图包含 15.5 个节点和 13.6 条边，且这两个数值通常随着结构复杂度的增加而上升。 关于这三个级别的详细定义、统计数据和性能分析，请参见附录 A。 每个源图均在五种基础支持的宽高比（9:16、2:3、1:1、3:2、16:9）下进行评估，从而生成 500 项重新布局任务。

paragraphs.en: We adopt a VLM-as-a-Judge protocol for reference-based evaluation. For each sample, the judge model compares the relayout result against the original flowchart under the target canvas size, and assesses whether the candidate preserves the original structure, content, layout adaptation, and visual style (Appendix H.1 , H.2 , H.3 , and H.4 ). We independently validate agreement between these VLM judgments and human assessments in Sec. 4.4 .
paragraphs.zh: 我们采用“VLM作为裁判”的协议进行基于参考的评价。 对于每个样本，裁判模型会将重新布局的结果与目标画布尺寸下的原始流程图进行比较，并评估候选方案是否保留了原始结构、内容、布局适配性和视觉风格（附录 H.1、H.2、H.3 和 H.4）。 我们在第 4.4 节中独立验证了这些 VLM 判断与人类评估之间的一致性。

paragraphs.en: Inspired by PaperBanana’s evaluation protocol ( Zhu et al., 2026a ) , we evaluate relayout results from two perspectives: Content Fidelity and Visual Quality .
paragraphs.zh: 受 PaperBanana 评估协议（Zhu 等人，2026a）的启发，我们从两个角度对重新布局的结果进行评估：内容保真度和视觉质量。

paragraphs.en: Content Fidelity. Content Fidelity has two binary checks. Relationship Preservation verifies that connector logic (source, target, and flow direction) matches the original. Hallucination-free Rate checks that no elements are added or omitted. Each is pass/fail; the score is the pass ratio.
paragraphs.zh: 内容保真。 内容保真包含两项二元检查。 关系保留用于验证连接器逻辑（源、目标及流向）是否与原始内容一致。 无幻觉率用于检查是否有任何元素被添加或遗漏。 每一项均为通过/未通过判定；分数即为通过率。

paragraphs.en: Visual Quality. Visual Quality contains two ranking-based metrics. Layout Quality ranks valid candidates by canvas utilization and overall arrangement, while penalizing trivial scaling, stretching, or simply rotating a landscape layout to fit a portrait canvas. Style Similarity ranks by preservation of original block colors, text styles, and connector styles. The judge jointly ranks all methods per sample; we report the average rank (lower is better).
paragraphs.zh: 视觉质量。 视觉质量包含两个基于排名的指标。 布局质量根据画布利用率和整体排列对有效候选方案进行排名，同时会对无意义的缩放、拉伸或仅为适应竖屏画布而对横屏布局进行简单旋转的行为进行扣分。 风格相似性根据原始色块颜色、文本样式和连接符样式的保留程度进行排名。 评判者针对每个样本对所有方法联合排名；我们报告平均排名（数值越低越好）。

paragraphs.en: Hierarchical scoring prioritizes content correctness over visual quality. Candidates are first ranked by the number of passed Content Fidelity checks, with two passes ranked above one pass and one pass above none. Ties are then ordered by the combined Layout Quality and Style Similarity. Finally, rank k k among N N candidates is mapped to ( N − k ) / ( N − 1 ) × 100 (N-k)/(N-1)\times 100 .

paragraphs.en: We conduct a user study on 50 cases, each with one source flowchart and five candidate relayouts (ours and four baselines), yielding 250 outputs in total. paragraphs.en: We present an agentic pipeline for aspect-ratio-adaptive flowchart relayout, refitting a raster flowchart to an arbitrary target canvas while preserving structure, content, and visual style in a draw.io-editable output. The pipeline decomposes the problem into three stages: Parse, Style, and Layout. Each stage is guarded by a Critic Agent that pairs deterministic verification with VLM reasoning, so connectivity is explicitly checked and prevented from being silently broken. Experiments on FlowchartRelayoutBench and a user study confirm substantial gains over image-generation and agentic figure-generation baselines, particularly on structural and Content Fidelity. Limitations are discussed in Appendix B .
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了一种智能体驱动的管道，用于实现宽高比自适应的流程图重新布局：它将光栅化流程图适配到任意目标画布中，同时保持结构、内容和视觉风格，并生成可在 draw.io 中编辑的输出。 该管道将问题分解为三个阶段：解析、样式设置和布局。 每个阶段都由一个评论智能体进行监督，该智能体将确定性验证与多模态语言模型推理相结合，从而显式检查连接性并防止其被静默破坏。 在 FlowchartRelayoutBench 上的实验和用户研究证实，与图像生成和智能体驱动图形生成的基线方法相比，本方法在结构完整性和内容保真度方面取得了显著提升。 相关局限性在附录 B 中进行了讨论。

paragraphs.en: Appendix A defines the easy, medium, and hard structural-complexity levels used to construct FlowchartRelayoutBench , reports node and edge statistics, and provides performance breakdowns across the three levels. Appendix B discusses limitations of the current method across style fidelity, VLM dependency, convergence, edge routing, and runtime cost. Appendix C provides qualitative comparisons complementing the quantitative ablation study in Section 4.5 , visualizing representative ablation variants and the conventional Graphviz DOT layout. Appendix D evaluates model transfer by replacing the proprietary VLM with an open-weight Qwen model and compares the full pipeline against direct XML generation and Qwen-based image editing. Appendix E presents our optional reference-guided style transfer extension and qualitative examples. Appendix F presents extended qualitative comparisons of our method against all four baselines across multiple flowchart examples and target aspect ratios. Appendix G provides the implementation prompts used by all six pipeline agents, while Appendix H provides the prompts used by the four VLM-based benchmark evaluators.
paragraphs.zh: 附录 A 定义了用于构建 FlowchartRelayoutBench 的简单、中等和困难结构复杂度级别，报告了节点和边的统计数据，并提供了三个级别上的性能分解分析。 附录 B 讨论了当前方法在风格保真度、VLM 依赖、收敛性、边路由和运行时成本方面的局限性。 附录 C 提供了对第 4.5 节中定量消融研究具有补充作用的定性比较，展示了代表性的消融变体以及传统的 Graphviz DOT 布局。 附录 D 通过用开源的 Qwen 模型替换专有 VLM 来评估模型迁移效果，并将完整流程与直接生成 XML 和基于 Qwen 的图像编辑方法进行了比较。 附录 E 介绍了我们可选的参考引导式风格迁移扩展及其定性示例。 附录 F 展示了我们的方法与全部四种基线方法在多个流程图示例和目标宽高比下的扩展定性比较。 附录 G 提供了所有六个流程智能体使用的实现提示，而附录 H 则提供了四个基于 VLM 的基准评估器所使用的提示。

paragraphs.en: We deliberately curate FlowchartRelayoutBench to cover source flowcharts with different levels of structural complexity. Rather than defining complexity only by diagram size, we consider how clearly diagram components and their relationships can be recovered from the raster input. We use three predefined levels: easy, medium, and hard.
paragraphs.zh: 我们特意对 FlowchartRelayoutBench 进行筛选，以涵盖具有不同结构复杂程度的源流程图。 我们没有仅通过图表大小来定义复杂性，而是考虑了如何从光栅输入中清晰地恢复图表组件及其关系。 我们使用了三个预定义的级别：简单、中等和困难。

sents.en: We use three predefined levels: easy, medium, and hard.
sents.zh: 我们使用了三个预定义的级别：简单、中等和困难。

paragraphs.en: Easy flowcharts contain clearly identifiable node boundaries, with connectors terminating unambiguously at their corresponding nodes. Relationships and flow directions are explicitly represented, with little ambiguity in either component identity or connectivity.
paragraphs.zh: 简单的流程图具有清晰可辨的节点边界，连接件明确无误地终止于其对应的节点。 关系和流向都有明确的表示，无论是组件身份还是连接性都几乎没有歧义。

For example, nodes may have irregular or weakly defined boundaries, or some connectors may be visually abbreviated or omitted while their source, target, and direction remain readily inferable from the surrounding structure.
paragraphs.zh: 中等复杂度的流程图保留了清晰的逻辑关系，但存在轻微的视觉模糊性。 例如，节点可能有不规则或定义不明确的边界，或者某些连接符在视觉上可能被简化或省略，但其来源、目标和方向仍能从周围结构中轻松推断出来。

paragraphs.en: As summarized in Table 5 , the final benchmark contains 25 easy, 40 medium, and 35 hard flowcharts. The structural statistics are consistent with increasing complexity: easy, medium, and hard examples contain on average 10.1, 14.3, and 20.8 nodes, respectively, and 9.4, 13.4, and 16.8 edges. Across the full benchmark, flowcharts contain 15.5 nodes and 13.6 edges on average. These statistics provide an additional quantitative characterization of the structural diversity represented in the benchmark.
paragraphs.zh: 如表 5 所示，最终基准测试包含 25 个简单、40 个中等和 35 个复杂的流程图。 结构统计数据与复杂度的递增趋势一致：简单、中等和复杂的示例平均分别包含 10.1、14.3 和 20.8 个节点，以及 9.4、13.4 和 16.8 条边。 在整个基准测试中，流程图平均包含 15.5 个节点和 13.6 条边。 这些统计数据为基准测试中所体现的结构多样性提供了额外的量化描述。

paragraphs.en: We additionally evaluate all methods separately on the easy, medium, and hard subsets to examine how source-diagram complexity affects relayout performance. As shown in Table 5 , Relationship Preservation and Content Fidelity generally decrease as structural complexity increases, indicating that the three subsets represent progressively more challenging cases. Our method achieves the highest Relationship Preservation, Hallucination-free Rate, Content Fidelity, and Overall score at every complexity level, while maintaining a lead of more than 20 percentage points in Content Fidelity over the next-best method across all three subsets.
paragraphs.zh: 我们还分别在所有方法在简单、中等和困难子集上的表现，以考察源图复杂程度如何影响重新布局效果。 如表 5 所示，随着结构复杂程度的增加，关系保持率和内容保真度通常会下降，这表明这三个子集代表了难度逐步提升的情况。 在所有复杂程度层级中，我们的方法都实现了最高的关系保持率、无幻觉率、内容保真度和总分，并且在所有三个子集中，其内容保真度都比次优方法高出超过 20 个百分点。

paragraphs.en: To examine how structural complexity affects refinement effort, we report the average number of iterations performed by each pipeline stage on the easy, medium, and hard subsets. As shown in Table 6 , total iterations increase with structural complexity, from 8.23 for easy to 9.08 for hard examples. The increase is most pronounced in the Layout Stage, while Parse iterations remain relatively stable, suggesting that structural complexity primarily increases the refinement required for spatial rearrangement.
paragraphs.zh: 为了研究结构复杂性如何影响优化工作量，我们报告了每个流程阶段在简单、中等和困难子集上执行的迭代次数平均值。 如表 6 所示，总迭代次数随结构复杂性的增加而上升，从简单示例的 8.23 次增加到困难示例的 9.08 次。 这种增长在布局阶段最为显著，而解析阶段的迭代次数则相对稳定，这表明结构复杂性主要增加了空间重排所需的优化工作。

paragraphs.en: Our XML-based reconstruction framework prioritizes editability over exact pixel preservation, which introduces an inherent visual style gap relative to methods that directly manipulate original image pixels. Although the generated diagrams remain structurally faithful and fully editable, subtle discrepancies in typography, icon rendering, spacing, or low-level visual appearance may still occur. Closing this gap while preserving editable graph structure remains an important direction for future work.
paragraphs.zh: 我们基于 XML 的重建框架将可编辑性置于精确保留像素之上，这使其与直接操控原始图像像素的方法相比，在视觉风格上存在固有的差异。 尽管生成的图表在结构上保持忠实且完全可编辑，但在字体、图标渲染、间距或底层视觉外观方面仍可能出现细微差异。 在保持图结构可编辑性的同时弥合这一差距，仍然是未来工作的重要方向。

paragraphs.en: Our main experiments rely on Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview, a proprietary multimodal model, which introduces limitations in reproducibility, accessibility, deployment cost, and privacy-sensitive usage scenarios. Future model updates outside our control may also affect output behavior. In Appendix D , we replace Gemini with the open-weight Qwen3.6-27B model. The proposed pipeline continues to outperform direct generation under the same VLM, but its substantially lower absolute structural fidelity shows that current performance remains sensitive to the capability of the underlying model.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的主要实验依赖于 Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview，这是一个专有多模态模型，它在可重复性、可访问性、部署成本以及对隐私敏感的使用场景方面存在局限性。 未来超出我们控制范围的模型更新也可能影响输出行为。 在附录 D 中，我们将 Gemini 替换为开源权重模型 Qwen3.6-27B。 在相同的 VLM 条件下，所提出的流程仍然优于直接生成方法，但其绝对结构保真度显著较低，表明当前性能仍对底层模型的能力较为敏感。

paragraphs.en: The proposed critic-guided refinement mechanism is heuristic rather than formally guaranteed. Each stage terminates after either receiving a passing judgment or reaching a fixed maximum number of iterations. Although the deterministic validators substantially reduce structural failures, the overall iterative process does not guarantee convergence or globally optimal layouts. In rare cases, outputs may still contain subtle visual artifacts or aesthetically suboptimal arrangements that are not detected by the VLM critic.
paragraphs.zh: 所提出的由评论者引导的优化机制是一种启发式方法，而非具有正式保证的方法。 每个阶段在收到通过判断或达到预设的最大迭代次数后终止。 尽管确定性验证器显著减少了结构故障，但整个迭代过程并不保证收敛或全局最优布局。 在少数情况下，输出可能仍包含微妙的视觉伪影或美学上非最优的排列，而这些是 VLM 评论者未能检测到的。

paragraphs.en: Our deterministic checker verifies the integrity of source–target connectivity relationships but does not explicitly optimize edge-routing aesthetics. As a result, diagrams with high node density, complex graph topology, or extreme aspect-ratio transformations may still exhibit unnecessary edge crossings, uneven spacing, or visually unnatural routing despite preserving correct connectivity.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的确定性检查器可以验证源-目标连接关系的完整性，但并未显式优化边的路由美观性。 因此，即使节点密度高、图拓扑复杂或宽高比发生极端变化，生成的图表仍可能出现不必要的边交叉、间距不均或视觉上不够自然的路由，尽管其正确的连接关系得到了保留。

paragraphs.en: The multi-stage agentic pipeline introduces substantially higher inference cost and latency than direct one-shot generation methods. Each relayout instance requires approximately 10–20 VLM API calls across the three stages, in addition to one SAM 3 inference pass. Runtime is dominated by remote API latency rather than local computation. While this overhead is manageable for individual editing tasks, reproducing the full benchmark evaluation may require sustained API throughput and incur non-trivial monetary cost under current commercial API pricing.
paragraphs.zh: 这种多阶段智能体流程带来的推理成本和延迟，远高于直接的一次性生成方法。 每次重新布局实例在三个阶段中大约需要 10–20 次 VLM API 调用，此外还需一次 SAM 3 推理过程。 运行时间主要受远程 API 延迟影响，而非本地计算。 虽然这种额外开销对于单个编辑任务而言尚可接受，但要完整重现基准测试评估，可能需要持续的 API 吞吐量，并且在当前商业 API 定价模式下会产生不小的费用。

paragraphs.en: This appendix details the optional reference-guided Style Transfer extension introduced in Section 3.5 . Given a completed relayout output X ∗ X^{*} and an unrelated reference image R R , the extension transfers the visual style of R R to produce a restyled XML X R ∗ X^{*}_{R} without altering structural or semantic content. Because R R and X ∗ X^{*} have no spatial correspondence, a Color Extraction Tool first quantizes colors in LAB space to obtain separate fill and stroke palettes from R R , after which a VLM assigns each palette entry to semantic roles such as background, primary fill, text, and connector color. A Style Agent then iteratively rewrites the style attributes of X ∗ X^{*} under Critic Agent feedback, while inferring non-color properties including corner roundness, font family, and arrow style directly from R R . A qualitative example is shown in Fig. 14 .
paragraphs.zh: 本附录详细介绍了第 3.5 节中引入的可选参考引导式风格迁移扩展。 给定一个已完成的重排输出 X* 和一个无关的参考图像 R，该扩展将 R 的视觉风格迁移到 X* 上，生成一个经过重新设计的 XML XR*，同时不改变其结构或语义内容。 由于 R 和 X* 之间没有空间对应关系，因此首先使用颜色提取工具在 LAB 空间中量化颜色，从 R 中分别获取填充和描边调色板，随后由 VLM 将每个调色板条目分配给背景、主要填充、文本和连接符颜色等语义角色。 接着，风格智能体在批评智能体的反馈下迭代重写 X* 的风格属性，同时直接从 R 中推断出非颜色属性，包括圆角程度、字体族和箭头样式。 一个定性示例如图 14 所示。
